research_object: Time-asymmetry inference from finite trajectories and record-bearing descriptions.
mandatory_invariants: Separate entropy production, coarse graining, record formation, and cosmological boundary conditions.
Use synthetic or public data only; label synthetic records as synthetic.
Treat cosmological content as a constrained toy-model or conceptual ledger unless an observational dataset and analysis are independently specified.
Include a falsifier and a non-identifiability outcome.
